name: Carlos R. Hernandez
headline: Product Engineer
shortIntro: I work close to the people who use a product: understanding how they work, figuring out what needs to change, and building the software with the team. My background is strongest in backend systems, APIs, integrations and data, but I stay involved from the first decisions through delivery and production support.
biography:
I'm a Product Engineer with 10+ years in software development. I've worked on products for businesses, built systems with client teams, and taken projects from an initial idea to software running in production. I like being close to both sides of the work: understanding the business problem and working through the technical details needed to solve it.

I don't see planning and coordination as separate from engineering. I enjoy breaking a goal into workable steps, making trade-offs clear, keeping people aligned and helping the team deliver. I still prefer to be hands-on: designing APIs and data flows, connecting services, building interfaces where needed, and supporting the software once it's live.

Most of my technical depth is in backend work: Node.js and TypeScript services, integrations between platforms that were never designed to agree, and the data model underneath. I also work on the frontend when the product needs it, and I've led small teams without leaving the code.
